michael-yen-ting-lin.text: In August 2026, Lin seconded and voted for (5-0) Affordable Rate Program changes setting a $15 monthly discount for new and renewing participants, supplemented with $18,053.53 in property tax revenue.

source.title: Walnut Valley Water District minutes, regular board meeting Aug. 17, 2026

notes: Michael Lin was appointed in mid-2026 to the Division V vacancy (Director Scarlett Kwong's final month on the board was May 2026); his recorded votes (July–Aug. 2026) were all unanimous. No campaign site, statements or news coverage found for Dennis Yang (WVWD minutes only record him attending the Aug. 17, 2026 meeting as a member of the public). Searches used: 6
